name.zh: 字段路径，支持点号与数组下标
name.en: Field path; dot notation and array indices are supported

label.zh: 校验上下文与字段标签
label.en: Field label used by validation and presentation

value.zh: 独立字段的外部同步值
value.en: External synchronized value for a standalone field

defaultValue.en: Initial value for a standalone field

rules.zh: 字段规则；与 Form、FormItem 规则合并
rules.en: Field rules, merged with Form and FormItem rules

required.zh: 标记必填并附加 required 规则；0、false 仍不是空值。
required.en: Mark as required and append a required rule; 0 and false still count as nonempty.

disabled.zh: 禁用交互并退出字段校验
disabled.en: Disable interaction and exclude the field from validation

readonly.zh: 禁止交互，仍保留字段校验
readonly.en: Prevent interaction while keeping validation active

active.zh: 字段是否激活；媒体内容项表示当前是否为激活项
active.en: Active validation field, or the active item for media renderers

preserve.zh: 字段卸载后是否保留模型值
preserve.en: Keep the model value after the field unmounts

validateOn.zh: 覆盖交互校验时机；文本默认 blur，其他字段默认 change
validateOn.en: Override interaction validation; text defaults to blur, other fields to change

appearance.zh: plain、underline 或 outline 的基础外观
appearance.en: Base appearance: plain, underline or outline

placeholder.zh: 未输入或未选择时的提示
placeholder.en: Hint displayed before input or selection

model.zh: 外部模型快照；相等回写不重复通知
model.en: External model snapshot; equal write-backs do not emit again

initialValues.zh: 初始化与 reset 的重置基线
initialValues.en: Initial values and the reset baseline

submitting.zh: 业务请求是否进行中，由普通页面同步
submitting.en: Application request state, synchronized by an ordinary Page

help.zh: 没有可见错误时显示的帮助文字
help.en: Help text displayed when no error is visible

labelPlacement.zh: 标签位置 top 或 left

options.zh: 选项；通常为 label、value、disabled，多列时为二维数组
options.en: Options with label, value and optional disabled; nested arrays for columns

labelKey.zh: 选项显示文字对应的键

childrenKey.en: Key used for nested tree options

variant.zh: list 或 buttons；Upload 使用基础布局类
variant.en: list or buttons; Upload uses its base layout class

collapseAfter.zh: 正数时折叠超出数量的选项，0 不折叠
collapseAfter.en: Collapse options beyond this positive count; 0 disables collapsing

columns.en: Number of columns in the option layout

requireValid.zh: 仅允许已知 valid 的 Form 触发提交
requireValid.en: Allow submission only when Form is already known to be valid

type.zh: 原生输入类型，默认 text
type.en: Native input type, text by default

maxlength.zh: 最大字符数；-1 不附加上限
maxlength.en: Maximum character count; -1 adds no limit

autoHeight.en: Let Textarea grow with its content

focus.zh: 原生焦点状态，实际行为受平台限制
focus.en: Native focus state; actual behavior is platform-dependent

adjustPosition.zh: 键盘弹起时是否自动上推
adjustPosition.en: Adjust the viewport when the keyboard opens

confirmType.zh: 原生键盘确认按钮类型

presentation.zh: native 或 popup，多选使用 popup
presentation.en: native or popup; multiple selection requires popup

multiple.en: Allow multiple selection in the popup

min.zh: 最早日期或时间，格式与 mode 一致
min.en: Earliest date or time, formatted for the selected mode

max.zh: 最晚日期或时间，格式与 mode 一致
max.en: Latest date or time, formatted for the selected mode

fields.zh: 原生日期精度 year、month 或 day
fields.en: Native date precision: year, month or day

defaultPickerValue.zh: 无模型值时滚轮的初始定位
defaultPickerValue.en: Initial picker position when the model has no value

weekdays.zh: 从周日开始的七个表头文字
weekdays.en: Seven weekday labels starting with Sunday

accept.en: Allowed media types: image and video

adapter.zh: 从 Form 注册表解析的上传适配器名称
adapter.en: Name of an upload adapter registered on Form

maxSize.zh: 文件大小上限，字节；0 不额外限制
maxSize.en: File size limit in bytes; 0 adds no limit

typeLimits.zh: 按 image、video 分别设置数量和大小限制
typeLimits.en: Per-type image/video count and size limits

autoUpload.zh: 选择后是否立即调用适配器上传
autoUpload.en: Start the adapter immediately after selection

retryCount.zh: 失败后的自动重试次数
retryCount.en: Number of automatic retries after a failure

item.zh: 内容数据；图片含 src、mode，视频另含 type、poster 等
item.en: Item data; images use src/mode, videos also use type, poster and related fields

index.zh: 当前内容项的零基索引

itemKey.zh: 稳定身份字段；重复身份退化为索引
itemKey.en: Stable identity key; duplicate identities fall back to indices

circular.zh: 是否循环；少于两项时自动关闭
circular.en: Looping; automatically disabled with fewer than two items

autoplay.zh: 是否自动切换或播放，仍受可见性和平台策略限制
autoplay.en: Automatic switching or playback, subject to visibility and platform policies

duration.zh: 轮播动画毫秒数；Video 为指定视频时长（秒）
duration.en: Carousel animation milliseconds; on Video, the specified media duration in seconds

peek.zh: 相邻项露出宽度，显式值覆盖版式默认值
peek.en: Visible neighbor margin; an explicit value overrides the layout default

gap.zh: 内容项间距，带 CSS 单位
gap.en: Gap between items, including a CSS unit

indicator.zh: 多项时是否展示内置指示点
indicator.en: Show built-in indicators when there are multiple items

autoObserve.zh: 是否按交叉可见性自动管理播放阻塞
autoObserve.en: Use intersection visibility to manage playback blocking

intersectionRatio.zh: 判断视频可见的交叉比例阈值

enableProgressTouch.zh: 启用自定义进度条触摸
enableProgressTouch.en: Enable touch interaction on the custom progress bar

paused.zh: 外部暂停阻塞，优先于可见性自动播放
paused.en: External pause blocker, taking priority over visibility-driven playback

showPlayBtn.zh: 显示原生底部播放按钮
showPlayBtn.en: Show the native bottom play button

showCenterPlayBtn.zh: 显示原生居中播放按钮
showCenterPlayBtn.en: Show the native center play button

stopFrame.en: Image displayed over a stopped video

autoPauseIfOpenNative.zh: 打开原生页面时自动暂停
autoPauseIfOpenNative.en: Pause automatically when opening a native page

vslideGesture.zh: 启用非全屏亮度和音量手势

vslideGestureInFullscreen.zh: 启用全屏亮度和音量手势

customClass.zh: 原生视频节点的附加类名
customClass.en: Additional class name for the native video node

customStyle.zh: 原生视频节点的内联样式
customStyle.en: Inline style for the native video node

soundStyle.en: Style for the custom sound control

playStyle.en: Style for the custom play control

replayCanBePaused.zh: 允许重播阶段点击暂停
